mapper.select: SELECT id, name, initial, version FROM categories WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY initial IS NULL, initial, name
SELECT id, name, initial, version FROM categories WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, name, initial, version FROM categories WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories (name, initial, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{initial}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE categories SET deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, updated_at = #{deletedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
